In the example: "王3某...挪用公款" (the cashier case). Here the person was a cashier, misappropriated public funds. In this case, the person is a director of an apartment, using position to divert funds. That is also "贪污". The label list includes "经济犯". In many Chinese classification, 贪污 is a type of economic crime. So likely the label is "经济犯". The label list includes "经济犯". So answer: [罪名]经济犯<eoa>
